caseName: Mobley v. Nix, Chairman, Georgia Board of Pardons and Paroles
caseNameFull: Mobley v. Nix, Chairman, Georgia Board of Pardons and Paroles, Et Al.

opinions.text: Sup. Ct. Ga. Application for stay of execution of sentence of death, presented to Justice Kennedy, and by him referred to the Court, denied. Certiorari denied.
